feature_contract.goal: Eliminate value-initialization and repeated reallocation of shipped R26+HUD stereo source/index staging during variable-sized VB/IB and IndexedPrimitiveUP draws; preserve exact range admission and original render fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R26+HUD R30 CPU scratch used for validated VB/IB readback and UP local index rebase. No renderer routing/eye projection, shader, SkyGlow, lens, +TIME, FFB, DX11, or DXVK edits.
trace_stages: Game Lock/Unlock populates independent CPU shadow and valid-byte intervals.
R30CopyVertexShadow/R30CopyIndexShadow first validate full requested range and then memcpy every staging byte.
R30 per-eye transforms read the fully copied temporary source; IndexedPrimitiveUP writes every rebased index slot before either eye draw.
Exact-SHA Active game builds R26+HUD owner; host smoke verifies capacity/reuse, 16/32 index and fallback coverage.
subcomponents: Replace zero-initialized std::vector<uint8_t> stereo readback source/indexSource with destructive, reusable uninitialized scratch, preserving size/data contracts.
Retain separate valid coverage on CPU shadow and fail-original-render behavior when data unavailable or allocation throws.
Exercise portable positive and negative staging regressions in the existing exact-SHA Windows smoke workflow.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All bytes copied from validated CPU shadow before transforms; reused capacity requires no zero fill on subsequent draws.
16/32-bit index rebasing fully overwrites staging; gaps/failures never admit unobserved game shadow data.
Exact-SHA Active game, host smoke, package, Domain and affected Full Source Impact succeed without HMD claims.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R26+HUD R30ScratchBuffers.source/indexSource were std::vector<uint8_t>; R30Copy*Shadow and index rebase invoke resize on varying requested byte counts even though all bytes are immediately overwritten.
diagnosis.root_cause: std::vector<uint8_t>::resize value-initializes newly enlarged logical spans in the draw-time source/index staging hot path, creating redundant CPU writes distinct from the previously fixed persistent CPU shadow backing.
alternatives_rejected: Do not bypass independent valid-range admission, skip CPU copy, reduce eye draw coverage, or reuse stale previously copied source/index data.
Do not alter the already-completed 00871/00872 CPU shadow interval/write allocation and its safety checks.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: New write-only staging buffer retains capacity, default-initializes uint8_t[capacity] without clearing, and drops previous payload on growth; readback and UP index loops already overwrite every logical byte before use.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Host smoke checks shrink/expand pointer reuse, complete per-draw overwrite, growth, 16-bit and 32-bit index slots, clear and independent gap rejection.

runtime_evidence: No actual Quest3/VDXR or same-scene CPU/GPU FPS measurement; source-confirmed redundant memory initialization, no hardware speedup claim.
